band.basis: Sum of seven distinct per-metre components: slotted deflection head track supplied and fixed (QV 92mm top-track proxy + proprietary uplift), soffit fixings at 600 crs (QV shot fix), mineral wool head packer (allowance), intumescent fire-rated acoustic sealant to both faces over bond breaker (QV Promaseal-a head-joint rate x2 faces), head trimming/taping/slip connection (QV stopping angle), mobile scaffold amortised (QV weekly hire), and compliance labelling (allowance). GST exclusive, Auckland subcontract rates, 2026, excluding preliminaries, margin, design/consent and producer statements. The seals carry the spread: the two-face fire-rated bead is $32.4/m at the QV rate, and every QV fire-sealant row lands above the $16/m you allowed for both faces. Two minor allowances (packer, labelling) are under 15% of the total. 60m nominal run: $3,847 to $6,468, midpoint about $5,160.

band.unit: $/m of partition head (also x60m for the nominal run)
band.basis: Auckland subcontract rates, GST exclusive, ex preliminaries, margin, design and consent fees. Sum of seven distinct components: track supply (QV proxy) 14.3-22.0; soffit fixings 3.5-7.0; mineral wool packer allowance 5-11; intumescent acoustic sealant both faces 32.4-46.2; head trimming/taping/slip connection 14.1-28.2; mobile scaffold amortised 6.6-13.2; compliance labelling allowance 0.5-2.0. Total for the 60m nominal run: about $4,600-$7,800, midpoint about $6,200. Allowances (packer + labelling) are only 7-10% of the total, so the band is rate-led, not allowance-led. Confidence low: the track rests on a QV proxy with a judgement uplift, the stop-joint row does not state per-face or per-run, and the specified intumescent grade is priced off a QV acrylic fire sealant. If the nominated tested system accepts a single-face sealant, the band repins at about $60-$106/m (midpoint about $83/m).

band.unit: $ per lineal metre of partition head
band.basis: Sum of the seven components above: low 10.68+3.51+6.00+16.40+19.20+6.62+0.50 = 62.91; high 12.81+8.18+12.00+32.40+36.20+13.23+2.00 = 116.82. Midpoint 89.9/m, i.e. 60m = $3,775 - $7,009 (mid $5,392). QV rates are unreviewed and the main drivers rest on proxies: the slotted head track is a supplier list price (QV publishes no deflection head track), and the intumescent bead is priced from QV's Promaseal-A fire-rated joint rate (a 15x13mm joint used for the 12x15mm bead, one line per face). Allowances (packer, labelling) are about 10% of the midpoint, so the band is not allowance-led. The band excludes GST, preliminaries, margin, design, consent fees and producer statements, and the partition itself below the head, as scoped. Single-face or non-intumescent sealant would take this to roughly $46-84/m - confirm the tested system's requirement before repinning.
